item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, importlib.util, json\\nfrom pathlib import Path\\n\\nspec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('work', 'work.py')\\nwork = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\\nspec.loader.exec_module(work)\\n\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['a'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}}, 'current':{'a':{'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['b','a','b'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file'},'b':{'kind':'file'}}, 'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','extra':1},'b':{'kind':'missing'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']}),\\n ({'declared':['a','ignored','irrelevant'], 'saved':{'ignored':{'kind':'file'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file'}}, 'current':{'ignored':{'kind':'missing'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file'}}, {'ignored':['ignored']}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['a'], 'saved':{}, 'current':{'a':{'kind':'missing'}}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['a'], 'saved':{'a':{'kind':'missing'}}, 'current':{}}, {'ignored':[]}, {'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n    req_before, pol_before = copy.deepcopy(req), copy.deepcopy(pol)\\n    got = work.evaluate(req, pol)\\n    assert got == expected, (got, expected)\\n    assert req == req_before and pol == pol_before\\n    assert set(got) == {'needs_review','changed'}\\n\\nrequests = json.loads(Path('requests.json').read_text())\\npolicy = json.loads(Path('policy.json').read_text())\\nreport = json.loads(Path('report.json').read_text())\\nassert report == [work.evaluate(req, policy) for req in requests]\\nassert all(set(item) == {'needs_review','changed'} and isinstance(item['needs_review'], bool) and isinstance(item['changed'], list) and all(isinstance(p, str) for p in item['changed']) for item in report)\\nprint('all checks passed')\"]}"}
